newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX after hour ACCESS trade halted after start.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX after hour ACCESS trade halted after start.

text.p: NYMEX overnight ACCESS trading was interrupted Thursday evening due to a technical problem.
NYMEX officials said they were unaware of the problem but were checking into the situation.
NYMEX officials later said the shutdown was being investigated, though no clear restart time was available.
"ACCESS shut at 4:40 p.m. EST (2140 GMT) due to technical difficulties and we are working on the problem," said a NYMEX spokeswoman.
Trade began at 4 p.m. EST (2100 GMT), it's normal start time. Crude oil, No. 2 heating oil, gasoline futures and options trade during ACCESS, as well as gold, silver, platinum futures.
